Who We Are

About Us

Our vision is to nurture the imaginative faculties and demeanour of our students, so as to mold them into creative, capable and confident future ready individuals upholding the core values of the school.

Creative Thinkers
Capable Individuals
Confident Future Leaders

To realise our vision, we have set the following key objectives for ourselves:

1
Adopting a deliberate and systematic approach to a topic to make the teaching-learning process as simple, easy and stimulating as possible.
2
Adopting a multipronged strategy to ensure better understanding and assimilation of the curriculum.
3
Creating an ecosystem through a set of specially designed programs to hone the written and verbal expressions of students in English, besides inculcating in them the ever essential passion for reading.
4
Developing amongst students a flair for public speaking by equipping them with a rich repertoire of English vocabulary, besides working on their body language, followed by desired practice and exposure.
5
Exposing students to as many extra co-curricular activities and sports as possible, and equipping them with the basic skill to play minimum two sports, besides encouraging them to pick up minimum one hobby each.

Our core values are summed up in three words fundamental to our existence:

I
Respect

Treating every individual with dignity, courtesy, and regard at all times.

II
Tolerance

Embracing diversity and fostering a spirit of inclusion and harmony within our school community.

III
Excellence

Striving to give our absolute best in every academic, creative, and athletic endeavour.

1
Always maintain a cheerful and positive demeanour. Be approachable to your students at all times.
2
Conduct yourself with grace. Remember, you are a role model for many of your students.
3
Never indulge in back-biting, cribbing and other negative, undesirable and ungainful activities. Use your spare time constructively for self improvement. Be respectful and cooperative towards your colleagues.
4
Never bluff while teaching. No one is expected to know everything on this planet. Whenever in doubt, refer to the book before progressing further. Remember, your students trust you blindly, and you ought to keep their trust.
5
Be humble and responsive to the bonafide requirements of the school management. Remember, you are expected to be part of the solution, not the problem.
1
Always be cheerful and think positive. Pay special attention to personal hygiene and sanitation.
2
Never criticise any person or a situation.
3
Never lie, cheat or steal. Correct those found to be doing so.
4
Be friendly and helpful to everyone at all times.
5
Respect your classmates and seniors and take care of your juniors.
6
Never wait for tomorrow to clarify your doubts.
7
Always strive for excellence in whatever you attempt.
8
Bring discipline into every aspect of your life.
9
Pick up minimum two sports and one hobby.
10
Protect your school property from misuse or damage.
Leadership

Chairman's Message

Lt Col AK Yadav (Retd)
Chairman, Fieldrush Public School
"A vision to create an institution that would nurture tender minds and inspire mutual respect, tolerance, and excellence."

About a decade ago, Fieldrush Public School began as a dream, a vision to create an institution that would nurture tender minds, and inspire mutual respect, tolerance and excellence, besides shaping responsible, future ready citizens. What started with determination, faith, and a commitment to quality education has today grown into one of the premier educational institutions of our area.

As I reflect on this remarkable journey, I feel immense pride and gratitude. Every milestone we have achieved has been possible because of the unwavering dedication of our teachers, the trust reposed in us by parents, and the hard work, perseverance and achievements of our students. Together, we have built not just a school, but a vibrant learning community founded on integrity, discipline, commitment and compassion.

At Fieldrush Public School, we believe that education extends beyond academic excellence. Our mission has always been to nurture confident, compassionate, and socially responsible individuals who are prepared to meet the challenges of an ever-changing world. We strive to provide an environment where children are encouraged to discover their unique talents, think independently, and develop into curious lifelong learners.

Over the past decade, the school has continually evolved by embracing modern teaching methodologies, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and holistic development opportunities, while remaining firmly rooted in the timeless values of character, honour and service.

With warm regards,

Chairman
Fieldrush Public School
Academic Leadership

Principal's Message

Ms. Meena Negi
Principal, Fieldrush Public School
"Education is a shared commitment between dedicated teachers, motivated students, and enthusiastic parents with high expectations."

Welcome to Fieldrush Public School. As Principal, it is a privilege to lead a vibrant academic community where character development, scientific inquiry, and creative expression are cultivated side-by-side.

Our curriculum is thoughtfully structured to encourage students to think critically, question constructively, and approach learning with curiosity and confidence. We emphasize not only intellectual rigor but also emotional resilience, empathy, and social responsibility.

We work in close partnership with parents and guardians to ensure that every student receives individual guidance, support, and the opportunities needed to realize their full potential in academic, athletic, and artistic spheres.

With best wishes,

Principal
